state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / template-applications / UUIDv5(programId, templateId+trimmed ApplicationKey); per-entry planned UUIDv5(applicationId,entryKey). Same application/proposal/disposition compares generated timestamps; drafts have stable exact receipt comparison. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / template-applications / existing UUIDv5 of ProgramId and TemplateId + trimmed ApplicationKey. ApplicationKey is the selected logical creation key; per-entry UUIDv5(applicationId, entryKey) and selected mutation CommandIds remain exact.
owners.invariant: One application pins exact published template provenance, fixed planned tenant draft identities and completion state; one pending later-version adoption proposal receives one immutable disposition before next successor.
owners.boundaryRationale: All-drafts-created is technical orchestration; each draft has own lifecycle in its real owner and needs no lifetime copy in parent domain state. Pending successor/version ordering requires compact admission owner if decisions split.

owners.declaredIdentity: Create context.RequestId; Register exact retry currently conflict. Tenant commands mostly current-state idempotent; no stable per-transition intent identity. Append OCC.
owners.selectedIdentity: Caller TenantId is immutable tenant creation identity; lifecycle operations use caller CommandId.
owners.invariant: One tenant lifecycle activates only after its slug and first-administrator conditions; offboarding forbids new active service; one current slug transition admitted at a time.
owners.boundaryRationale: Tenant lifecycle and activation/current-slug link need coherence; global slug uniqueness belongs slug authority. Previous slug history and transport correlation need not live in tenant.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant+providerConnectionId; expectedRevision. TestKey/pending retry and result intent checks exist; Configure after revisions and older rotation retries not uniformly recognized.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + ProviderConnectionId with immutable tenant binding. Selected CommandId and TestKey bind exact configuration, test, key and rotation episodes.
owners.invariant: Connection enables only with successful test of current credential epoch; rotation invalidates pending/old result; disabled connection stays terminal.
owners.boundaryRationale: Credential epoch and activation decision must remain authoritative together. Test attempt lifecycle/history can be separate via explicit admission/epoch proof.

owners.invariant: One immutable offer, token acceptance and terminal lifecycle; each invitation has exact recipient, purpose, scopes and expiry.
owners.mustPreserve: Retry same invitation ID with exact terms returns original acceptance; changed terms conflict. New invitation generation is independent. Delivery retries preserve exact token and accepted at-least-once policy.

owners.invariant: At most one pending invitation per mailbox. InvitationId and generation live in state and every release compares both; generation is never part of the stream key.
owners.mustPreserve: Retry same invitation ID with exact terms returns original acceptance; changed terms conflict. New invitation generation is independent. Delivery retries preserve exact token and accepted at-least-once policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant singleton, observed Sequence value, reasons per member, append OCC. Reasons suppress immediate duplicate withdrawal but no operation/generation token binds source write or restoration.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant singleton manager guard in its existing address. Selected CommandId binds exact contributor/member episode, generation and withdrawal/restoration transition; current complete eligible contributors remain authoritative.
owners.invariant: Removal from effective administrator set must leave another active tenant administrator.
owners.boundaryRationale: Without a shared authoritative decision/hold two removals could each rely on the other. The coordination boundary is justified; guard-to-member transition protocol is incomplete.

owners.declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 normalized slug. Register current same owner emits duplicate fact; rejection emits reply receipts; expected-position OCC enforces competing claims.
owners.selectedIdentity: Existing UUIDv5 of normalized slug. Selected CommandId binds exact claimant tenant and reservation episode; the existing normalization and UUID algorithm remain unchanged.
owners.invariant: One normalized global slug can belong to one tenant and once surrendered is permanently retired.
owners.boundaryRationale: Global claim/retirement must be atomic; tenant activation and reply transport need not be in same owner.

owners.invariant: One normalized training requirement creation and version line.
owners.mustPreserve: Original creation identity remains recognizable after revisions; each revision uses expected version and valid audience/source.
